detailZones.title: Socks and scarf in the lid
detailZones.description: A pair of gray socks and a striped scarf are visible through the mesh divider in the suitcase lid. The ends of the scarf have a cream fringe.

detailZones.title: Folded shirts and trousers
detailZones.description: Dark trousers sit beside a pale blue button-down shirt and a coral T-shirt. Their pockets, buttons and collars are exposed between the straps.

detailZones.title: Suitcase handle, lining and straps
detailZones.description: A black carrying handle sits above the open case. Two gray straps cross over the clothes and clip together, and a wide fabric hinge joins the halves.

detailZones.title: Suitcase shell and wheels
detailZones.description: A teal hard shell runs across the base of the case. The black wheel assemblies have small gray hubs and spokes.

detailZones.title: Toiletry bag and brushes
detailZones.description: An open bag holds a mesh bath pouf, a plain squeeze tube and a clear bottle. A toothbrush, comb and wooden hairbrush lie beside it.

detailZones.title: Shoes and laces
detailZones.description: Two matching blue shoes have white toe caps and laces. The bows leave the eyelets, tongues and pale insoles visible.

detailZones.title: Sunglasses and belt
detailZones.description: The dark lenses sit in a mottled frame. Below them, a brown belt is coiled with its metal buckle facing outward.

detailZones.title: Towel and travel adapter
detailZones.description: A thick gray towel lies beside a white travel adapter on the wooden tabletop. Two plug pins are visible at the side of the adapter.

anchorAudit.rationale: The points land on visible suitcase parts, exposed garments, accessories and textures. Clothing points avoid crossed straps. The type of liquid inside a closed bottle, baggage limits and transport fees cannot be identified visually.
